name: Side-view clash cut-in
oneLiner: When a turn or tactics battle confirms an attack, the game cuts to a staged side-view scene: both units on a ground strip in front of a backdrop that matches the terrain, the attacker leaps in, winds up and swings (or shoots, or casts), the hit lands with a freeze frame, sparks, a damage number and an HP bar that drains, misses are dodged, criticals get a gleam and a flash, the counter-attack follows, a fallen unit fades away, and both return before the scene closes. Skippable, with a x2 speed toggle. The game passes the outcome it already decided; the module only stages it, so what you see always equals the game's own numbers.
fits: tactics / strategy RPG (grid map, attack + counter exchanges)
turn-based RPG with single-target physical or spell attacks
monster battler or card battler that wants a dramatic attack scene
wargame or skirmish game with a battle animation toggle
notFor: real-time action games (no confirm step; the cut-in would pause the action)
attacks that hit many units at once (stage one pair per cut-in)
games whose combat is already shown in a side view (the cut-in would repeat it)
games that want the exchange to stay on the map: use A-18 on-map-skirmish instead (same family, pick one)

needs: the moment the game has confirmed an attack and resolved it with its own rules: attacker and defender, each strike in order (who strikes, hit / miss / crit, damage) and both HP values before and after

each unit's sprite (image or canvas plus the side its art looks at; a painted variant for the other side when the art must not be mirrored) or a draw callback, name, team, max HP, and optionally its map x, weapon name and forecast numbers
a fixed update step (ms), the screen rect to cover (native px), and a place to pause the game's own world, autoplay and input while busy() is true
provides: onDone({att, def, skipped}) when the scene has closed: resume the game there
onImpact({i, by, result, dmg, after}) once per strike at the moment it lands (sound, rumble, other effects)
busy(), state() (who stands where, facing, shown HP), rect() of the covered area

assets: module/clash-cutin.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_ClashCutin): timeline, poses (leap, wind-up, swing, recoil, dodge, fall), backdrops drawn in code for five terrains (plains, forest, marsh, desert, ruins) with three parallax layers, slash arcs, sparks, arrows and spell orbs, damage / MISS / CRITICAL pops, HP panels with a draining bar, letterbox caption bar, skip and x2; draws through GameDNA_Skin when skin-api.js is loaded, otherwise with its built-in copy of the pixel16 look
no image or audio files: units are the game's own sprites
